Part of [H: Systemic hormonal preparations, excluding sex hormones and insulins](../).

**Also worth knowing.**
Levothyroxine is treated as a narrow therapeutic index drug, with bioequivalence tightened to 0.90-1.11 [@concordet2019levothyrox; @concordet2020be200].
Binding globulins shift with pregnancy and oral estrogen, changing unbound fraction [@arafah2001estrogen; @alexander2004pregnancy].
